title: AI API data terms: training, retention and zero retention
question: What does each AI provider say happens to data sent to its commercial API: is it used for training, how long is it kept, and can zero retention be had?
scope: Commercial API offerings from major AI model providers and hosts, with a separate row where a provider has routes with distinct terms, such as free and paid tiers. Records what each provider's own pages state, not what happens in practice. Consumer apps are left out. A blank means we couldn't find it in the provider's own pages, not that the answer is no. A cell holds one passage, so a provider may have more exceptions than the one shown: open the source. Each row reflects the page as read on the date shown. Not legal advice.

columns.label: Provider
columns.rule: The company offering the API, as named on its own page.

columns.label: Offering
columns.rule: The API, tier or platform the row covers, in the provider's words.

columns.label: Trains on API data by default
columns.rule: True or false only where the text plainly says what happens to this offering's API data with no opt-in or opt-out by the customer. An opt-out with no stated default is left blank. Where pages differ: legal or privacy page first, then help or trust pages, then developer docs, with the other in conflicts.

columns.label: Default retention
columns.rule: How long prompts and outputs are kept by default, in the provider's words. Where pages differ: legal or privacy page first, then help or trust pages, then developer docs, with the other in conflicts. A page that's only less specific isn't a conflict: the more specific statement is the value.

columns.label: Exceptions
columns.rule: The main case with different retention, in the provider's words: first a model carved out of the general promise, then a feature, then a case such as flagged content. Pages rank as for Default retention; between pages of equal rank, the one naming the models. One passage only, so others may exist.

columns.label: Zero retention offered
columns.rule: True only where the provider plainly offers zero data retention by that name for this offering; false only where it plainly excludes it. A similar control under another name is left blank here and described in How to get it.

columns.label: How to get it
columns.rule: What the provider says is needed for zero retention. Where it has no offer by that name, its nearest named control or pointer, in its own words. Where pages differ: legal or privacy page first, then help or trust pages, then developer docs, with the other in conflicts.

columns.label: BAA available
columns.rule: True where the provider says it signs or offers a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, or sets terms for use under one, for this offering. A general cloud BAA that the page doesn't tie to this offering, or an invitation to ask, is left blank.

columns.label: Data location
columns.rule: Where the provider states data is processed or stored, in its words. Where pages differ: legal or privacy page first, then help or trust pages, then developer docs, with the other in conflicts.
